dogecoin.text: Damn, Dogecoin almost hit 7 cents earlier this morning. This is > 7 times when I first got to know of its existence less than two months back.

Dogecoin isn't money; it's an instrument to hoard before one dumps it to get Dollars. Anyone who says otherwise is either sly enough to stoke the bubble for profit, or gullible enough to hold it until it goes to zero.
